rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken comparison for something being better in quality than something else.

example.english: The goods from this shop are superior to those from that one.
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 pou3 di1 fo3 hou2 gwo3 go2 gaan1

rows.note: Use this for higher rank, status, grade, or quality rather than an ordinary comparison.

example.english: This hotel is far superior in quality.
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 gou1 kap1 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this when someone is one level above others in ability, status, or standing.

example.english: They are clearly superior to everyone else at this job.
example.traditional: 佢哋做呢份工真係高人一等。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zou6 ni1 fan6 gung1 zan1 hai6 gou1 jan4 jat1 dang2

rows.note: Use this attributive construction for a part or object located above another one.

example.english: The book above the cabinet is on the top shelf, in a superior position.
example.traditional: 櫃上面嘅書擺喺最高嗰層。
example.jyutping: gwai6 soeng6 min6 ge3 syu1 baai2 hai2 zeoi3 gou1 go2 cang4
